Oval Ring Clamp Comes with an oval ring clamp, offering a secure and reliable hold on the hairdryer, enhancing user control and stability. product.desc:
Soft Hose Material



Made with soft hose material, the pet hairdryer provides a comfortable grip and reduces the risk of slipping during use.






Oval Ring Clamp



Comes with an oval ring clamp, offering a secure and reliable hold on the hairdryer, enhancing user control and stability.






Hairdryer Nozzle Connection



Features a hairdryer nozzle connection, ensuring a secure and stable attachment for effective drying.






Dual Motor Design



Equipped with a dual motor, this pet hairdryer ensures efficient and powerful drying, perfect for quick grooming sessions.






Adjustable Suction Tube



The adjustable suction tube allows for versatile use, catering to different breeds and sizes of pets for optimal hair drying.

Note: This product is xiaomi ecological chain brand product,there is no any xiaomi marks on the products, please note it.

Description:
Xiaomi Mijia Pawbby Pet Shaver - A perfect artifact for designing a cool hair style for your lovely pets.
Long endurance, professional rounded shaving head and other considerate details.

Features:
- One-button detachable shaving head, easily removable and washable, convenient to clean
- 2000mAh battery, once fast charging for Max. 4-hour working time
- Three-layer noise canceling, advanced noise canceling technology + high-end copper motor + small motor rotating axis
- Professional safe rounded shaving head with strong trimming power.
- Smart battery monitoring with red and white light.
- Ergonomic curved body, comfortable fits for long-time hand holding without fatigue.

Specifications:
Brand: Xiaomi Pawbby
Product: Pet Shaver
Model: MG-HC001
color: white
Material: ABS
Rated Power: 5W
Power input: DC 5V 1A
Battery: 2000mAh
USB Cable Length: 1.5m
Charging Time: About 4 Hours
Product weight: Approx. 190g/4.70oz
Product size: Approx. 17.5*4.4*3.5cm/6.89*1.73*1.38in
Package weight: Approx. 400g/14.11oz
Package size: Approx. 19*8*4cm/7.48*3.15*1.57in

Note:
1.Item color may show slight aberration due to different shooting light and monitor display.
2.The battery use time and standby time depend on the actual use situation.

Package list:
1 * Shaver
1 * USB Cable
2 * Combs
1 * Brush
1 * lubricating oil

Powbby
PAWBBY PET SHAVER

Safety Cutter Head
Anti-card
Low Vibration
Low Noise
Long-lasting Use

SIMPL E OPERATION

Even a shaver that can be easily operated by novices,
the owner can design a satisfactory shape for the pet.

SAFE ROUND CUTTER HEAD
The touch-faced cutter head adopts a special R-typ obtuse angle cutter head treatment process,the skin contact does not scratch the skin, and the novice operation can also ensure the construction safety.

Safety Test:
close to the palm of your hand and palm test

Near Finger Test

Close to the inside of the arm, wrist

PROFE SSIONAL PET CUTTER HEAD

28 fine tooth pet professional cutter head,constant pressure constant speed setting.Wear-resistant ceramic movable knife and stainless steel fixed knife double trim. Powerful motor high speed motor can trim different soft and hard density hair, trimming without stucking hair.

Safe & Wear Resistant:Ceramic Moving Knife

Do Not Stuck Hair:Stainless Steel Fixed Knife

Strong Uniform Trim:Powerful Motor High Speed Motor

TRIPL E NOISE REDUCTION

Triple noise reduction technology, ceramic cutter head,reduce friction noise; high quality brass motor to reduce mechanical noise;ultra short motor shaft to reduce vibration noise.

Reduce Friction Noise:Ceramic Cutter Head

Reduce Mechanical Noise:Brass Motor

Reduce Vibration Noise:Ultra-short Motor Shaft

POSITIONING COMB

With two hair length positioning combs,
3/6mm, 9/12mm four hair lengths to choose.

Fast Charging Long-lasting Use
Large-capacity 2000mAh lithium battery,fully charged in 3 hours, sufficient operation for about 4 hours, long-lasting use,which is efficient and convenient.

3-hour Fast Charge

2000mAh Large Capacity

Intelligent Monitoring Of Power
When charging or shaving, the indicator light shows the current battery status in real time, thoughtful design, monitoring power at any time, intelligent reminder, to avoid card emission caused by insufficient power, to ensure safe and efficient use.

Chargeing Red Light Is always On

Full Power/Working White Light Is Always On

Low Battery Reminder Flashing Red Light

The Cutter Head Is Disassembled For One Second.
The detachable cutter head is designed to facilitate the cleaning of short hairs and the fingers can be removed by gently pushing them.

One-button Removal

The Head Can Be Washed

Soft Curved Body Comfortable Grip
The ergonomically designed streamlined, soft- curved body fits the palm of your hand for long periods of time without fatigue.

Packing List

1.Shaver 2.Adjustable Positioning Comb

3.Lubricating Oil 4.Cleaning Brush

5.1.5m USB Charging Cable 6.Manual

title: [Carton of 4] Altimate Pet Antibacterial Potty Pad Fresh Scent | Petico Premium Pet Supplies
detail_text: Altimate Pet Potty Pads are 100% leakproof, highly absorbent pads infused with fresh scent for enhanced odor control. Made with Leak Proof Multilayer technology, these heavy duty pads are built to withstand overflow. The fast-drying top layer also prevents tracking, so you don’t have to worry about your pup stepping into his mess. Whether you are using them for puppy training or to assist aging dogs, these pads are a great way to keep your floors clean and provide your furry friend with relief. INSTRUCTIONS Training Instructions: 1. Place the potty pad with the quilted side up in a designated area ( pee tray / floor ) so that your pet will be able to start using. 2. Try to encourage your pet to go to the potty pad on a regular basis. When it is time, walk your pet over to the pad and use whatever command that feels natural (i.e. Go potty! Do the business!). 3.When your pet successfully uses the pad, it is vital to reward your pet with positive reinforcement and even small rewards. By doing this consistently, your pet will link this behavior with praise and will be more inclined to make the behavior a ritual. 4.It may take a few days or even weeks before your pet becomes comfortable using the potty pad regularly. However with consistent training schedules and rewards, this method has a very high success rate. Available in 3 sizes S - 33cm x 45cm (180 pads) M - 45cm x 60cm (100 pads) L - 60cm x 90cm (50 pads)
detail_html:
Altimate Pet Potty Pads are 100% leakproof, highly absorbent pads infused with fresh scent for enhanced odor control. Made with Leak Proof Multilayer technology, these heavy duty pads are built to withstand overflow. The fast-drying top layer also prevents tracking, so you don’t have to worry about your pup stepping into his mess. Whether you are using them for puppy training or to assist aging dogs, these pads are a great way to keep your floors clean and provide your furry friend with relief.

INSTRUCTIONS

Training Instructions:

1. Place the potty pad with the quilted side up in a designated area ( pee tray / floor ) so that your pet will be able to start using.

2. Try to encourage your pet to go to the potty pad on a regular basis. When it is time, walk your pet over to the pad and use whatever command that feels natural (i.e. Go potty! Do the business!).

3.When your pet successfully uses the pad, it is vital to reward your pet with positive reinforcement and even small rewards. By doing this consistently, your pet will link this behavior with praise and will be more inclined to make the behavior a ritual.

4.It may take a few days or even weeks before your pet becomes comfortable using the potty pad regularly. However with consistent training schedules and rewards, this method has a very high success rate.

Available in 3 sizes

  • S - 33cm x 45cm (180 pads)
  • M - 45cm x 60cm (100 pads)
  • L - 60cm x 90cm (50 pads)

product.desc:
Easy Maintenance



This mat is easy to maintain, requiring no special care or cleaning, making it convenient for busy pet owners.






Mango Green Color



The pure mango green color adds a touch of elegance to any room while blending seamlessly with your decor.






Non-Slip Design



Featuring a non-slip design, this mat prevents accidents and keeps your pet safe while they rest.






Thickened Pet Mat



This pet mat is thickened for added comfort and durability, making it perfect for your furry friend.






Waterproof and Urine-Resistant



The mat is waterproof and urine-resistant, ensuring it remains clean and hygienic even with frequent use.

Durable and Long-lasting



Built to last, this pet mat withstands heavy use, making it a cost-effective choice for pet owners.

Waterproof PVC Material

detail_html:
Top-selling P.A.W.S is now available in Pet Spa Gloves!!!!!!

P.A.W.S Full Body Pet Spa Gloves offer a convenient, user-friendly solution that is free of chemicals and alcohol. They are gentle and safe on sensitive skin, effectively eliminating bacteria, germs, viruses, and odours while relieving skin irritation. Suitable for pets of all life stages, these gloves are the ideal choice for cleaning your pet's body. This perfect pet cleaning product contains no surfactant, preservatives, or colouring.

  • Easy-to-use
  • Multipurpose
  • Chemical and alcohol-free
  • Gentle and safe on sensitive skin
  • Eliminate bacteria, viruses and odour
  • Relieves skin irritation
  • Suitable for even kittens and puppies
  • Improved softness
  • Medical grade sterilization

Achieve thorough cleaning by:

  1. Put on gloves (you can use both sides of the gloves)
  2. Wipe the pet all over your pet's body, including sensitive areas like the eyes. (Please start by cleaning less dirty regions (such as the head and face) before cleaning areas that are dirtier (such as the paws, bum bum, and under-tummy).
  3. Switch to the other side of the gloves by switching to another hand
  4. Dispose the gloves properly (if you are wearing rings, please take note the rings are not trapped in the gloves before disposing)

Choose natural ingredients over chemical-based products for your pet, family and environment!

Ingredient: Electrolyzed Water with Pear Pattern Gloves Wipes

Bundles: 2packs, 6 packs or 15 packs of P.A.W.S Full Body Pet Spa Gloves (each pack contains 2pcs of gloves)

Storage: Keep out of direct sunlight and high heat

Store Safely: Store unused gloves in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight (Must keep them air-tight) - It is highly recommended not to keep them after opening.

Expiry: 2 years from manufacturing date (unopened)

Warranty: 2 years from manufacturing date (If have an issue for newly opened packet)
